capacity.description: Maximum rated operational throughput or holding capacity.

reliability.description: Historical on-time or fulfillment probability (0.0 to 1.0).

inventory_days.description: Available stock runway or buffer measured in days of standard consumption.

safety_stock_days.description: Protected reserve buffer maintained for emergency stockouts.

congestion.description: Current congestion or bottleneck severity percentage at this node.

share_of_supply.description: Proportion of total network input volume sourced through this node.

share_of_volume.description: Proportion of total network cargo flowing through this transit node.

importance_weight.description: Strategic criticality score of this node to the entire network.

transit_time_days.description: Baseline transit duration under normal conditions.

transport_cost_per_unit.description: Standard freight cost per unit along this corridor.

congestion.description: Transit corridor congestion or choke-point severity percentage.
